Talia O'Brien
talia.obrien@example.com | Detroit, MI
Talia O'Brien has 5 years of experience in backend and distributed systems.
Most recently, Senior Backend Engineer at Nimbus Infrastructure (2025-2026),
where they applied distributed-systems patterns to scale the platform to 202K
concurrent users. Before that, Backend Engineer at Grayline Digital
(2021-2025). Education: B.S. Computer Engineering, UC San Diego, 2020. Core
skills: Kafka, Node.js, REST API design, GraphQL, Docker, Distributed systems,
CI/CD.
